Suddenness & Familiarity.description: The patient's immediate perception of the event as sudden or unfamiliar.

dimensions.suddenness: The patient finds the situation sudden or abrupt.

dimensions.unfamiliarity: The patient finds the situation unfamiliar.

Event Predictability.description: Whether the patient expected the event itself to occur.

dimensions.predictability_of_event: The patient was expecting the event to happen.

dimensions.unpredictability_of_event: The patient wasn't expecting the occurrence of the event.

Consequence Predictability.description: Whether the patient could foresee the outcomes of the event.

dimensions.predictability_of_consequences: The patient can easily anticipate the consequences of the event.

dimensions.unpredictability_of_consequences: The patient had no idea about what the consequences of the event would be.

Cause & Responsibility.description: The patient attributes the cause of the event to themselves.

dimensions.self_cause: The patient caused the event themselves.

dimensions.self_control: The patient has control over what is going on in the event.

Control & Power.description: The patient attributes the cause of the event to someone else.

dimensions.other_cause: Someone/Something other than the patient caused the event.

dimensions.other_control: Someone/Something other than the patient controls what is going on in the event.

Goal & Norm Conflict.description: The event conflicts with the patient’s goals, expectations, or sense of what should have happened.

dimensions.goal_incongruence: The outcome of the event is not aligned with the patient's goals/desires.

dimensions.norm_violation: The actions that produced the event violated the patient's standards and ideals.

Coping & Impact Severity.description: The patient finds dealing with the event's consequences overwhelming or difficult to endure.

dimensions.coping_demand: The patient has to spend a great deal of (physical or mental) energy to handle the outcome of the event.

dimensions.unacceptable_consequences: The consequences of the event are unbearable for the patient.
